## Activity

During August 2021, North City Eye Clinic recorded 51 captures. This figure represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity record provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the same reporting period. No additional activity measure is included in this report.

## Image quality

Of the 51 captures, 1 was assessed as ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 2.0 per cent. The result is reported separately from the grading outcome so that image suitability can be considered before interpreting the clinical assessment. The image-quality figures apply to the activity recorded at North City Eye Clinic during August 2021.

## Grading

Grading identified 17 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 1 day. This measure provides the reported central indication of the time taken for grading during August 2021. Together, the referable result count and the median lag summarise the grading activity associated with the 51 captures. The figures should be read alongside the image-quality result, including the 1 ungradable capture and the 2.0 per cent ungradable rate.
